description: Import a receipt directly from an https:// URL (S3, Drive shared link, public file host, etc.). The server fetches the file behind an SSRF guard (rejects private IPs, Moneda infra, and non-https), validates it, then runs OCR + matching. Single tool call, no sandbox needed. Use this when the receipt is already accessible at a URL.

captureSource.description: Provenance label for the audit trail. Defaults to MANUAL_UPLOAD.

fileName.description: Override the auto-derived filename. Defaults to the last path segment of the URL.

mimeType.description: Override the Content-Type the source server returns. Useful when the source serves application/octet-stream.

url.description: https:// URL the receipt file can be fetched from. Public hosts only (S3, Drive shared, etc.).

name: import_receipt_from_url
